honesty_rules: A trait ships ONLY if at least one observed signal matches it. No match, no trait.
The read states what the signals show and nothing more. No motivations, no inner life, no psychology.
self_view quotes self-stated signals only. If none matched the trait, it says so plainly.
Signals that match no trait are listed as ungrouped in notes — never invented into a trait.
Confidence is mechanical: high = 3+ signals on 2+ distinct dates, medium = 2 signals, low = 1 signal.
